decisions.maskingSource: tree-sitter grammar comment/string nodes via parseForSafety.mask (the JS/C-only codeMask is deleted)
decisions.bodyDetection: bodyOffsets consumes the per-language mask so braces inside comments/strings are not body delimiters
decisions.sqlBlockComment: tree-sitter-sql names /* */ blocks 'marginalia'; isCommentNodeType now recognizes it
decisions.retireCodeMask: no character-scanning mask remains in the edit path

limitations: Vue/Svelte embedded <script> content is an opaque raw_text node (the JS grammar is not injected in the bundled WASM), so // comments inside it are not masked — but no identifiers or braces are parsed there either, so bb_edit rename/insert are unaffected. Tracked as analyzer completeness.
Markdown HTML comments (<!-- -->) parse as html_block, not comment, and are not masked — markdown has no identifiers or brace bodies, so bb_edit is unaffected.
